evidence: result:the installed checkpoint contract carries the rewritten UI self-verify section, both installed templates carry the UI line and the documentation-suggestion line, the UI self-verify and documentation-suggestion test cases pass from the installed copy, and test-setup-teardown.sh runs green (57 cases)
result:the same 4 errors as since 0.56.0 remain in test_workflow_checkpoints (cases that read repository files outside the package)
command:claude -p "<keep building to the next checkpoint>" --permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools ...

result:a temporary project was set up with the installed copy (its convention block carries both new lines) holding a static page with a form, and one approved module -- the only, therefore last, module -- whose single task changes the submit button text; neither the Plan nor the prompt mentioned UI verification or documents

result:one run: inside the task the session opened the page in headless Chrome, checked both Spec criteria one by one (the button reads the new text; clicking still shows the thank-you line), reported no console errors and that it looked at a screenshot; at the final gate it listed the changed files and the commit, and gave a close-out documentation suggestion with an explicit README stance (no README needed for a one-file static page; other documents: none)
